color_policy: Top faces sample the saved final colored full model; cut walls use a darkened adjacent terrain color to avoid a separate grey rim, and underside uses neutral print grey.
gpx_trace_policy: GPX trace geometry is split against the retained-land mask. Land components become terrain-following insert solids and recess pockets; water components become separate low-profile printable pieces. Through-holes are not used.

cut_wall_projection.note: Cut walls are required for watertight land-only models; this metric tracks whether the visible closure wall projects into removed-water cells and creates a rim-like artifact.

flat_fit_insert_export.fit_policy: Flat-bottom insert generated from the same retained-land GPX footprint used for recess authority. This is the slicer-friendly print insert; source GPX component export remains lineage/reference geometry.

validation_stl_report.axis_transform: MyRace3D Y-up to slicer Z-up: (x,y,z)->(x,z,y), reverse face winding, center XY, minZ=0

insert_export.fit_policy: Land GPX components are exported as source-relief fit-authority geometry with no vertical normalization. The separate flat-fit insert remains the slicer-friendly print-layout model until terrain-following support generation is implemented. GPX components over removed water are exported separately as low standalone printable pieces and are not used to cut terrain recesses.

flat_fit_insert_export.fit_policy: Flat-bottom insert generated from the same retained-land GPX footprint used for recess authority. This is the slicer-friendly print insert; source GPX component export remains lineage/reference geometry.
